errors.text_span: wobei ich die Unterteilung in Einkommensgruppen in Abständen von 20.000 Euro sage
errors.evidence: The description states the income groups are in intervals of 20,000 Euro, but this is an over-generalization. The intervals are 20,000 up to the 100,000 Euro mark, but then the interval becomes 100,000 Euro ('100 - < 200') and finally an open-ended interval ('≥ 200').

errors.text_span: wobei ich die Unterteilung in Einkommensgruppen in Abständen von 20.000 Euro sage
errors.evidence: The phrase 'wobei ich ... sage' ('whereby I say') is awkward and not appropriate for a factual, objective description.
The description states there are five bars, but the chart clearly shows seven bars.

errors.text_span: Der kleinste Balken für "0-<20" hat einen Wert von ungefähr 60 Millionen Euro
errors.evidence: This incorrectly identifies the smallest bar. The smallest bar corresponds to the '0 - < 20' category, but its value is 0, not 60 million Euro. The value of 60 million Euro belongs to the '≥ 200' category.

errors.text_span: der höchste Balken für "40-<60" einen Wert von ungefähr 580 Millionen Euro hat
errors.evidence: The highest bar does have a value of 580 million Euro, but it corresponds to the '80 - < 100' income group, not the '40 - < 60' group, which has a value of 220 million Euro.

errors.text_span: Die Balken haben in der Reihenfolge der angegebenen Einkommensgruppen folgende ungefähren Werte: 60 Millionen Euro für "0-<20", 10 Millionen Euro für "20-<40", 220 Millionen Euro für "40-<60", 310 Millionen Euro für "60-<80" und 350 Millionen Euro für "80-<100".
errors.evidence: This sentence incorrectly assigns values to categories and is incomplete. For example, the value for '0-<20' is 0 (not 60), the value for '60-<80' is 350 (not 310), and the value for '80-<100' is 580 (not 350). It also completely omits the bars for '100 - < 200' (value 310) and '≥ 200' (value 60).
